bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
src=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot
head=807cea978e88b04cffbc27eb4497183671ac79cf
root=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed
scan="$root/.releases/$head/video-threeway-conflict-scan/merged"
target="$root/.releases/$head/common-stars-conflict-free"
old=create-videobot:pre-common-stars-807cea97
new=create-videobot:common-stars-807cea97-tested
test -s "$scan/src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs" && test -s "$scan/src/telegram/salesPanel.mjs" || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 62
test "$(docker image inspect create-videobot:local-poll --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" || exit 63
test ! -e "$target" && test -z "$(docker images -q "$new")" || exit 64
for p in src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs src/telegram/salesPanel.mjs;do
 if grep -q '^<<<<<<< ' "$scan/$p";then exit 65;fi
done
mkdir -p "$target/src/telegram" "$target/test"
for p in src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs src/telegram/salesPanel.mjs;do cp "$scan/$p" "$target/$p";done
for p in test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs test/salesPanel.test.mjs test/pgUnifiedStarsSales.test.mjs;do
 git -C "$src" show "$head:$p" > "$target/$p" || exit 66
done
docker tag create-videobot:local-poll "$old" || exit 67
{ echo "FROM $old";echo 'USER root';for p in src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs src/telegram/salesPanel.mjs test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs test/salesPanel.test.mjs test/pgUnifiedStarsSales.test.mjs;do echo "COPY --chown=node:node $p /opt/videobot/$p";done;echo 'USER node';} > "$target/Dockerfile"
docker build --network none --pull=false -t "$new" "$target" >/dev/null || exit 68
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node "$new" --check /opt/videobot/src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs || exit 69
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node "$new" --check /opt/videobot/src/telegram/salesPanel.mjs || exit 70
if ! docker run --rm --network none -w /opt/videobot --entrypoint node "$new" --test test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs test/salesPanel.test.mjs test/pgUnifiedStarsSales.test.mjs > "$target/test-results.log" 2>&1;then
 echo VIDEO_COMMON_STARS_REGRESSION=FAIL
 grep -E '^not ok |^# pass |^# fail ' "$target/test-results.log" | head -n 20 || true
 exit 71
fi
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 72
test "$(docker image inspect create-videobot:local-poll --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" || exit 73
echo VIDEO_COMMON_STARS_CONFLICT_FREE_TEST=PASS
echo VIDEO_RUNTIME_MUTATION=NO
